install: set -euo pipefail; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export TZ=Asia/Jakarta' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export TZ=Asia/Jakarta' >> ~/.bashrc; export TZ=Asia/Jakarta; if git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 && git remote get-url origin >/dev/null 2>&1; then git config remote.origin.fetch '+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*'; git fetch --all --prune || true; fi; if [ ! -f .env ] && [ -f .env.example ]; then cp .env.example .env; fi; if [ -f .env ]; then sed -i 's/^NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_NAME=\([^"]* .*\)$/NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_NAME="\1"/' .env; fi; (cd backend && go mod download && go test ./...); (cd frontend && if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; else npm install --no-package-lock --no-audit --no-fund; fi && npx --no-install tsc --noEmit --incremental false); if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait postgres; if [ -f .env ]; then set -a && source .env && set +a; fi; for f in database/migrations/*.sql; do docker compose exec -T postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "${POSTGRES_USER:-cmms_app}" -d "${POSTGRES_DB:-cmms_db}" < "$f" >/dev/null; done; fi
